camel_example: aliyun quotas ListQuotaUtilizationReport --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken  --ProductCode ecs --QuotaCategory CommonQuota --MaxResults 10 --UtilizationStatuses.1 WARN --KeyWords abc --Adjustable true --QuotaRegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
kebab_example: aliyun quotas list-quota-utilization-report --quota-category CommonQuota --key-words abc --product-code ecs --quota-region-id cn-hangzhou --adjustable true --utilization-statuses '["WARN"]' --next-token  --max-results 10 --api-version 2020-05-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQuotaUtilizationReport

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Performs a fuzzy match based on the quota name or quota ID
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键字，按配额名称或配额 ID 模糊匹配
parameters.name: key_words

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviation of the cloud service name.

For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of a cloud service name, see `ProductCode` in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html中的0
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the quota belongs, such as cn-hangzhou. If you do not specify this parameter or leave it empty, quotas are not filtered by region
parameters.help_zh: 配额所属地域 ID，例如 cn-hangzhou，不传或为空白时不按地域筛选
parameters.name: quota_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter quotas by adjustability. Valid values:
true: Queries only adjustable quotas.
false: Queries only non-adjustable quotas.
Not specified: Does not filter quotas by adjustability
parameters.help_zh: 是否按可调整性筛选。true：仅查询可申请调整的配额；false：仅查询不可申请调整的配额；不传：不按可调整性筛选
parameters.name: adjustable

parameters.help_en: The utilization statuses. You can specify multiple values. If you do not specify this parameter or pass an empty list, quotas are not filtered by utilization status
parameters.help_zh: 使用率状态，可传多个值，不传或传空列表时不按使用率状态筛选
parameters.name: utilization_statuses

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the NextToken value from the previous response as is, and keep the quota type and filter conditions consistent. Do not parse or construct the token yourself
parameters.help_zh: 分页令牌。首次查询不传；后续查询原样传入上次响应的 NextToken，并保持配额类型及筛选条件一致。不要自行解析或构造令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for this query
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

ErrorMsg.example: You are not authorized to do this action or the API input parameter is invalid.

GeneratedAt.description_en: The time when the data was generated or the statistical date. For general quotas, the value is in UTC and formatted as yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'. For API rate limits, the value is formatted as yyyy-MM-dd
GeneratedAt.description_zh: 数据生成时间或统计日期。通用配额为 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'；API 速率配额为 yyyy-MM-dd

Message.description_en: The supplementary description of the report status, such as report generation in progress, report generation needs to be started first, or a newer report is available for re-query. Applications should use Status to determine the status
Message.description_zh: 报告状态的辅助说明，例如报告生成中、需要先启动报告，或已有更新报告可重新查询。程序应使用 Status 判断状态

NextToken.description_en: The token for querying the next page. An empty value indicates that no more pages exist
NextToken.description_zh: 查询下一页的令牌。为空表示没有下一页

Quotas.description_en: The list of quota usage on the current page. An empty list is returned if no matching data is found or no general quota report is available
Quotas.description_zh: 当前页的配额使用情况列表。无匹配数据或无可用通用配额报告时为空列表

Adjustable.description_en: Indicates whether the quota is adjustable

Consumable.description_en: Indicates whether the used quota is displayed
Consumable.description_zh: 是否显示“已使用”的配额

AlgoType.description_en:
The type of the throttling algorithm. Valid values:
FixedWindow: fixed window
TokenBucket: token bucket
Concurrency: concurrency limit
AlgoType.description_zh:
限流算法类型。
FixedWindow：固定窗口；
TokenBucket：令牌桶；
Concurrency：并发限制

Period.description_en: The time period. This parameter is returned only for FixedWindow and is empty for other algorithms
Period.description_zh: 时段，仅 FixedWindow返回，其他算法为空

PeriodUnit.description_en:
The unit of the quota calculation period. Valid values:
second: seconds
minute: minutes
hour: hours
day: days
week: weeks
PeriodUnit.description_zh:
配额计算周期的单位。取值：
second：秒。
minute：分钟。
hour：小时。
day：天。
week：周

PeriodValue.description_en: The value of the quota calculation period

RefillInterval.description_en: The time interval between two token refills. This parameter is returned only for TokenBucket and is empty for other algorithms. The time unit must be confirmed with the upstream service and is not declared in the current code
RefillInterval.description_zh: 两次补充令牌之间的时间间隔，仅 TokenBucket 返回，其他算法为空。时间单位需向上游确认，当前代码未声明

TokensPerRefill.description_en: The number of tokens refilled each time. This parameter is returned only for TokenBucket and is empty for other algorithms
TokensPerRefill.description_zh: 每次补充的令牌数量，仅 TokenBucket 返回，其他算法为空

ProductCode.description_en: The abbreviation of the cloud service name

QuotaDescription.example: The maximum number of security groups that can be owned by the current account.

UnadjustableDetail.description_en: The reason why the quota is not adjustable

UsageMetric.description_en:
The monitoring information of the quota usage in CloudMonitor.

An empty value indicates that no monitoring data is available for this quota in CloudMonitor
UsageMetric.description_zh:
配额用量在云监控（CloudMonitor）中的监控信息。

空表示云监控中无此配额监控数据

additionalProperties.description_en:
The CloudMonitor monitoring dimensions.

Format: a collection of `key:value` pairs. Example:
`{"productCode":"***","metricKey":"***","regionId":"***","label":"***"}`
additionalProperties.description_zh:
CloudMonitor监控维度。

格式：`key:value`键值对形式的集合，例如：
`{"productCode":"***","metricKey":"***","regionId":"***","label":"***"}`

MetricDimensions.description_en:
The CloudMonitor monitoring dimensions.

Format: a collection of `key:value` pairs. Example:
`{"productCode":"***","metricKey":"***","regionId":"***","label":"***"}`
MetricDimensions.description_zh:
CloudMonitor监控维度。

格式：`key:value`键值对形式的集合，例如：
`{"productCode":"***","metricKey":"***","regionId":"***","label":"***"}`

Utilization.description_en: The quota utilization rate, without the percentage sign
Utilization.description_zh: 配额使用率，不带百分比

UtilizationStatus.description_en:
The risk level determined by the returned Utilization value. Valid values:
NORMAL: less than 80%
WARN: greater than or equal to 80% and less than 95%
CRITICAL: greater than or equal to 95%
UtilizationStatus.description_zh:
按返回的 Utilization 判定的风险等级：
NORMAL：＜80%；
WARN：≥80% 且＜95%；
CRITICAL：≥95%

Status.description_en:
The query result status of the quota utilization report. Valid values:

AVAILABLE: The data is available for query.

GENERATING: A new report is being generated. If an unexpired historical report exists, the most recent historical report is returned.
UNAVAILABLE: No general quota report is available. You must call StartQuotaUtilizationReport to start report generation first
Status.description_zh:
配额使用率报告的查询结果状态。取值：

AVAILABLE：数据可查询。

GENERATING：新报告生成中，且如果存在未过期的历史报告，会返回最近一次的历史报告。
UNAVAILABLE：没有可用的通用配额报告，需要先调用StartQuotaUtilizationReport启动报告生成

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet all filter conditions in the current report, not the number of entries on the current page. The value is 0 if no matching records are found
TotalCount.description_zh: 当前报告中符合全部筛选条件的记录总数，不是当前页条数。无匹配记录时为 0
